title: 第6章 双足飞龙第7章 出事

第六章 双足飞龙
安度因絮絮叨叨的交代似乎还在耳边，林立却不得不独自一人，在一片茂密的森林里艰难摸索着，一路摸索就一路在心里嘀咕：“老家伙有没有搞错，连假身份证都帮我准备了，怎么就忘了准备地图？”
老法师大概是这个世界上最了解林立的人了，他知道林立的身份有问题，所以为他准备好了新的身份，但他恐怕怎么也想不到，这家伙不是身份有问题，而是根本没有身份，落日山脉绵延数千里，来自另一个世界的林立，又怎么可能在其中找到出路？
说起来也怪不得安度因疏忽，谁又能想象得到，一个精通药剂学的魔法天才，在方向感上却是如此的低能。
安度因离开之后不到一天，林立就收拾好了自己的行装，可到现在已经十几天过去了，这家伙却连落日山脉的东南西北都还没搞清楚。
树林里幽暗阴森，地上铺满了腐败的落叶，每一脚踩下去，都好象踩在淤泥上一般不断往下陷去，那恶心的腐臭气息，更是熏得林立连眼都没法张开，黑暗中时而闪过几点幽幽的绿光，此起彼伏的狼嚎更是听得林立心惊胆战。
林立已经在这片森林里转了三天了，自从三天前踏进这片森林，林立的心情就再没好起来过，这见鬼的森林就仿佛一座庞大的迷宫，不管林立从哪里出发，也不管他在森林里怎么摸索，等到他精疲力尽想坐下来休息的时候，似乎都总会发现，眼前的树木看上去竟是如此的眼熟……
一直走到今天早上，林立终于听见了一些声音。
才刚刚穿过一片密林，林立就忽然看见，前方树丛中一阵叶浪翻腾，三条人影正在那一片叶浪当中飞速移动。
“我靠！我靠！活人！”向来以斯文人自诩的林立，却在片刻间连说了两个“我靠”，因为他实在太激动了，他居然真的看见了三个活人。
虽然这三个大活人很可能马上变成死人，但不管怎么说，至少他们现在还是活的。
只见前方树丛中一阵叶浪涌动，三名受伤的人类拼命的逃出树林，其中那名手握长剑的中年男人似乎受了相当重的伤，一道长长的伤口从胸口延伸到腰腹，滚烫的鲜血从伤口中喷涌而出，在铺满落叶的地面上拉出一条长长的血痕。
扶着中年男人一路奔逃的是一对年轻男女，那男的身上穿着一件做工精细的魔法长袍，看上去应该是出身不错的魔法师才对，特别是手上那根法杖，就算是以林立的眼光看来，也不得不说声不错。
只可惜眼前的形势，实在很难让一个魔法师发挥作用，在剧烈的奔跑当中，身体孱弱的魔法师甚至已经成了累赘，于是大多数时候，都是那位有着一头金色长发的美女在照顾两人，这姑娘长得本就漂亮，又穿着一件紧身的红色软甲，在快速的奔跑当中，更是勾勒出无限美好的曲线，左手扶着伤者，右手倒提着一把短剑，顾盼之间流露出的气质，连藏身林间的林立都忍不住多看了她几眼。
至于他们身后穷追不舍的，却是一头暴怒的双足飞龙，它的怒火来源于腹部的伤口，伤口又深又长，看上去应该是由某件锋利的武器所留下的。
“好刺激！”双足飞龙刚一现身，林立两只眼睛顿时直了。
当初在木屋里住着的时候，安度因就曾经给他介绍过落日山脉上的各种魔兽，提到七级魔兽双足飞龙时，安度因很欢乐的说了一句：“双足飞龙的血液用来做狂暴药剂不错。”
当然这种话也只有安度因敢说，对于一般冒险者来说，七级魔兽绝对拥有瞬间将三个活人变成死人的能力。
无比锋利的爪子，迅捷如风的飞行速度，再加上腐蚀能力极强的酸液喷吐，让双足飞龙拥有了在落日山脉边缘生存下去的资本，等闲魔兽如狮蝎雷兽之流，根本就不敢招惹它们，一头暴怒的双足飞龙，从天空中倾泻下无穷无尽的酸液，这对谁来说恐怕都是一场噩梦。
老实说林立也怕，但他更怕在这片见鬼的森林，想要走出这片森林，就不能看着双足飞龙将那三个活人全变成死人，有时侯做好事的理由其实就这么简单。

当然以林立的性格，就算是被逼做好事，也一定会先保证自己不吃亏。
就看见双足飞龙俯冲而下，飞溅的酸液洒在树丛当中，刹时间一片青烟直冒，紧接着就是一阵“滋滋滋”的声响此起彼伏，还没等那青烟散尽，郁郁葱葱的树木已是一片枝黄叶落的景象。
正拼命逃跑的三人虽未被酸液溅到，却也因为躲避酸液而稍稍停住了脚步，这一停在平时可能没什么问题，但如今却正好让他们落入了双足飞龙的利爪之下，三人刚一抬头，就看见一片阴影在视线中飞快放大，锐利的爪子在黑暗中闪动着摄人的光亮。
而与此同时，林立也完成了冰甲术的咒文。
随着最后一句咒文被喝破，一层坚硬无比的冰甲覆盖在中年男人身上，在止住伤口鲜血喷涌的同时，也让双足飞龙势在必得的一击落到了空处，那种感觉就象抓到了钢铁上一般，锥心的疼痛从爪子上传来，让双足飞龙发出一阵阵痛苦而愤怒的嘶吼声。
而惊魂未定的三人却趁机摆脱了双足飞龙，顺势躲入茂密的树丛当中。
然后他们就看见了一个身穿法师长袍的少年从树林间走出，口中吟唱着晦涩难明的魔法咒文，一发冰锥撕开空气呼啸而出，不偏不倚刚好扎进了双足飞龙腹部的伤口，冰锥并不锋利，若是平时，绝不足以洞开双足飞龙坚韧的皮肤，即便是此时扎进伤口，这个低级法术也无法给它带来多大的伤害。
这发冰锥术唯一可以做的，就是将它身上的伤口扩大数倍，原本又深又长的伤口，刹时间就仿佛一条沟壑一般，鲜血如雨一般喷溅而出，甚至就连内脏也正拼命的在腹腔中涌动……
而真正致命的，却是那根始终卡在伤口中的冰锥，这根冰锥不但刺伤了双足飞龙的内脏，还从根本上阻止了伤口合拢，鲜血就好象
做完这一切之后，林立还落井下石的放出了一记迟缓术。
鲜血乱喷的双足飞龙本就极端虚弱，此时一记迟缓术上身，更是仿佛拉着破车的老牛，任它如何拼命挣扎，那区区十几步距离，也仿佛成了一道永远无法跨越的鸿沟。
双足飞龙的悲鸣声中充满了绝望，这种情绪一直伴随着它咽下最后一口气。
“糟糕！”确定眼前的七级魔兽已经死去，林立才忽然想起件事来：“太浪费了！这么多血全流到了地上，这可能做不少狂暴药水呢……”
眼看双足飞龙已经死去，那受伤的中年男人扶着四周的树干，挣扎着从树丛中走了出来，他想要上前去感谢自己的救命恩人，可才刚走两步，却看见救命恩人正拿着一只玻璃瓶，拼命的挤压着双足飞龙的尸体。
“真的一点都没有了？帮帮忙……再挤一点，只要一点点就好了，好歹让我弄一瓶狂暴药剂试试啊……”
这仿佛吸血鬼一般的举动落入三人眼中，顿时只觉一阵毛骨悚然……
最后还是那受伤的中年男人胆子大一点，战战兢兢的走了过去：“尊敬的魔法师先生，感谢您的慷慨援助……”
听见中年男人道谢，林立这才想起正事来。
“不用客气，举手之劳而已。”林立将装了半瓶的飞龙血塞了起来，小心翼翼的放进法师袍口袋，这才笑咪咪的自我介绍道：“叫我费雷就可以了，对了，我能不能多嘴问一句，三位是怎么惹上这双足飞龙的？”
这是安度因为他准备的新身份，一路上林立早已背得滚瓜烂熟，此时随口说来自然而又顺口，就好象他本名就叫费雷似的。

中年男人没有想到，这个看起来强大而神秘的少年魔法师，竟是如此的平易近人，一时间多多少少有些受宠若惊，当下又是一番诚恳的致谢，然后才为他介绍起一行三人来。
受伤的中年男人名叫麦格雷尼，加洛斯城众多冒险者之一，这一次进入落日山脉，是接受了冒险者公会的一个任务，目的是为了取得一只狮蝎的尾刺，而那个有着一头金色长发的美女，则是他的女儿，名叫伊娜，她同样是一位冒险者。
至于那个看上去家世不错的魔法师，麦格雷尼介绍时却有些语焉不详，只说他叫克伦威尔，是在路上遇到的一位热心魔法师先生。
林立听到这里就想笑，什么热心的魔法师先生，想泡你女儿才对吧，不然谁吃饱了撑的跑来落日山脉装热心……
“本来一切都很顺利，经过几天的搜索，我们很快就在森林北边发现了一只落单的狮蝎，于是今天早上，我们在它巢穴附近布下了一个陷阱。”麦格雷尼脸上露出一丝苦笑：“然后我们就藏在树林里等它上勾，可谁知道那个陷阱没有引来狮蝎，却引来了两头双足飞龙，天知道这究竟是怎么回事，原本只是为狮蝎设下的陷阱，却彻底激怒了这两头双足飞龙，它们向树林里发起了攻击，我杀死了其中一头，却被它临死前的反扑重伤，克伦威尔先生不得不带着我跟伊娜逃出树林……最后很幸运的遇上了您，如果没有您出手，我真是不知道该怎么办才好了……”
“真不幸……”林立一脸遗憾，心里却暗自庆幸，还好你们遇上了双足飞龙，不然我上哪找人带路去，这见鬼的森林可比双足飞龙难对付多了……

Chapter 6 Bipedal Flying Dragon
Anduin's rambling instructions seemed to still be in his ears, but Lin Li had to grope alone in a dense forest, muttering in his heart: "Did the old guy make a mistake? He even prepared a fake ID for me, why did he forget to prepare a map?"
The old mage was probably the person who knew Lin Li best in the world. He knew that Lin Li had a problem with his identity, so he prepared a new identity for him. But he probably never imagined that this guy didn't have a problem with his identity, but that he had no identity at all. The Sunset Mountain Range stretches for thousands of miles. How could Lin Li, who came from another world, find a way out of it?
It's no wonder that Anduin was negligent. Who could have imagined that a magic genius who was proficient in pharmacy would be so incompetent in his sense of direction.
Less than a day after Anduin left, Lin Li packed his luggage, but more than ten days have passed, and this guy still hasn't figured out the southeast, northwest, and northwest of the Sunset Mountains.
The woods were dark and gloomy, and the ground was covered with rotting leaves. Every time you stepped on it, you felt like you were stepping on mud, sinking down continuously. The disgusting rotten smell made Lin Li unable to open his eyes. A few faint green lights flashed in the darkness, and the howling of wolves made Lin Li frightened.
Lin Li has been wandering in this forest for three days. Ever since he stepped into this forest three days ago, Lin Li's mood has never been better. This damn forest is like a huge maze. No matter where Lin Li starts from or how he explores in the forest, when he is exhausted and wants to sit down and rest, he always seems to find that the trees in front of him look so familiar...
Until this morning, Lin Li finally heard some sounds.
Just after passing through a dense forest, Lin Li suddenly saw a wave of leaves rolling in the trees in front of him, and three figures were moving rapidly among the waves of leaves.
"Holy shit! Oh shit! Living people!" Lin Li, who had always prided himself as a gentleman, said "Holy shit" twice in a row because he was so excited that he actually saw three living people.
Although these three living people are likely to turn into dead people soon, no matter what, at least they are still alive now.
I saw a wave of leaves surging in the trees ahead, and three injured humans tried their best to escape from the woods. Among them, the middle-aged man holding a long sword seemed to have been seriously injured. A long wound extended from his chest to his waist and abdomen. Hot blood spurted out from the wound, leaving a long blood trail on the ground covered with fallen leaves.
A pair of young men and women were supporting the middle-aged man as he ran away. The man was wearing a finely crafted magic robe. He seemed to be a magician with a good background. Especially the staff in his hand, even from Lin Li's perspective, it had to be said to be good.
It's a pity that the current situation makes it difficult for a magician to be effective. During the fierce running, the weak magician has even become a burden, so most of the time, the beauty with long golden hair is taking care of the two of them. This girl is so good-looking. She was beautiful, and she was wearing a tight-fitting red soft armor. She was even more beautiful in her curves as she ran fast. She was supporting the injured person with her left hand and holding a dagger in her right hand. The temperament she showed in her gaze made even Lin Li, who was hiding in the forest, couldn't help but look at her a few more times.
As for what was chasing after them, it was a furious flying dragon. Its anger came from the wound on its abdomen. The wound was deep and long, and it looked like it should have been left by a sharp weapon.
"So exciting!" As soon as the flying dragon appeared, Lin Li's eyes suddenly widened.
When he first lived in the wooden house, Anduin once introduced him to various magical beasts in the Sunset Mountains.When the seventh-level monster was a wyvern, Anduin said happily: "The blood of the wyvern is good for making violent potions."
Of course, only Anduin dares to say this. For ordinary adventurers, a level seven monster definitely has the ability to turn three living people into dead people in an instant.
Incomparably sharp claws, flying speed as fast as the wind, and spitting out extremely corrosive acid, give the flying dragon the capital to survive on the edge of the Sunset Mountains. Ordinary monsters such as the manticore and the manticore do not dare to provoke them. A furious flying dragon pours endless acid from the sky. This is probably a nightmare for everyone.
To be honest, Lin Li was also afraid, but he was even more afraid of being in this haunted forest. If he wanted to get out of this forest, he couldn't watch the flying dragon turn all three living people into dead people. Sometimes the reason for doing good things is actually that simple.
Of course, with Lin Li's character, even if he is forced to do something good, he will first ensure that he does not suffer any loss.
I saw the two-legged flying dragon swooping down, splashing acid into the trees. For an instant, a cloud of green smoke burst out, followed by a burst of "sizzling" sounds. Before the green smoke dissipated, the lush trees were already a scene of yellow branches and fallen leaves.
Although the three people who were trying to escape were not splashed by the acid, they stopped slightly to avoid the acid. This stop might not be a problem in normal times, but now they fell into the claws of the flying dragon. As soon as the three people raised their heads, they saw a shadow quickly enlarging in their sight, and the sharp claws flashed with an eye-catching light in the darkness.
At the same time, Lin Li also completed the ice armor spell.
As the last spell was broken, a layer of extremely hard ice armor covered the middle-aged man's body. While stopping the blood from the wound, it also allowed the flying dragon to hit the air with a sure blow. The feeling was like being caught on steel. Heart-pounding pain came from the claws, causing the flying dragon to let out bursts of painful and angry roars.
But the three people who were still in shock took the opportunity to get rid of the flying dragon and hid in the dense trees.
Then they saw a young man wearing a mage's robe walking out of the woods, chanting obscure magic incantations. An ice pick ripped through the air and roared out. It just pierced the wound on the belly of the flying dragon. The ice pick was not sharp. Normally, it would never be enough to open the tough skin of the flying dragon. Even if it penetrated the wound at this time, this low-level spell would not be able to cause much damage to it.
The only thing this ice pick technique can do is to expand the wound on its body several times. The originally deep and long wound suddenly became like a ravine, blood spewed out like rain, and even the internal organs were desperately surging in the abdominal cavity...
But what is really fatal is the ice pick that is always stuck in the wound. This ice pick not only stabs the internal organs of the flying dragon, but also fundamentally prevents the wound from closing. The blood is like
After doing all this, Lin Li added a Slowness Technique to add insult to injury.
The two-legged flying dragon, which was spraying blood, was already extremely weak. At this time, a slow spell was applied to the body, and it was like an old ox pulling a broken cart. No matter how hard it struggled, the mere dozen steps seemed to become a gap that could never be crossed.
The wyvern's screams were full of despair, and this emotion accompanied it until it breathed its last breath.
"Oops!" After confirming that the seventh-level monster in front of him was dead, Lin Li suddenly remembered something: "What a waste! So much blood flowed to the ground, this may make a lot of violent potions..."
Seeing that the flying dragon was dead, the injured middle-aged man struggled to walk out of the bushes, holding on to the surrounding tree trunks. He wanted to step forward to thank his savior, but he just took two steps and saw his savior.He was holding a glass bottle and squeezing the body of the flying dragon desperately.
"Is there really nothing left? Help me...squeeze a little more, just a little bit will be fine. At least let me get a bottle of violent potion to try..."
This vampire-like behavior fell into the eyes of the three of them, and they suddenly felt a chill...
In the end, the injured middle-aged man was braver and walked over cautiously: "Dear Mr. Magician, thank you for your generous assistance..."
Hearing the middle-aged man thank him, Lin Li thought of business.
"You're welcome, it's just a piece of cake." Lin Li stuffed the half-filled bottle of flying dragon's blood and carefully put it into the pocket of the mage's robe. Then he introduced himself with a smile: "Just call me Feyre. By the way, can I ask more, how did the three of you get into trouble with this two-legged flying dragon?"
This was the new identity that Andu had prepared for him. Lin Li had already memorized it by heart along the way, and he said it casually and smoothly, as if his real name was Feyre.
The middle-aged man did not expect that this seemingly powerful and mysterious young magician would be so approachable. He was somewhat flattered for a moment, and then he sincerely thanked him, and then introduced the three of them to him.
The injured middle-aged man's name was McGraney, one of the many adventurers in Garros City. This time he entered the Sunset Mountains to accept a mission from the Adventurer's Guild. The purpose was to obtain the tail stinger of a manticore, and the beauty with long golden hair was his daughter named Ina. She was also an adventurer.
As for the magician who seemed to have a good family background, McGraney was a little vague when introducing him. He only said that his name was Cromwell and that he was an enthusiastic magician whom he met on the road.
Lin Li wanted to laugh when he heard this. Mr. Magician, who is so enthusiastic, only wants to pick up your daughter. Otherwise, who would come to the Sunset Mountains to pretend to be enthusiastic...
"Everything was going well. After a few days of searching, we soon found a lone manticore in the north of the forest. So this morning, we set up a trap near its lair." McGraney showed a wry smile on his face: "Then we hid in the woods and waited for it to take the bait. But who knew that the trap didn't attract the manticore, but it attracted two bipedal flying dragons. God knows what happened. What happened? It was originally just a trap set for Manticore, but it completely angered these two wyverns. They launched an attack in the woods. I killed one of them, but was seriously injured by its counterattack before it died. Mr. Cromwell had to take Ina and I to escape from the woods... In the end, I was lucky enough to meet you. If you hadn't taken action, I really don't know what I would have done..."
"What a pity..." Lin Li looked regretful, but he was secretly glad in his heart. Fortunately, you met the wyvern. Otherwise, where would I have found someone to lead the way? This damn forest is much more difficult to deal with than the wyvern...
